name: The Lost Caravan
summary: After Encroaching Wildlife, Watcher Biggs has a further matter for you. Stunned in the Lost Ones' attack on the caravan, Biggs still saw a wagon hauled off to the Fallow Sanctuary, the Lost Ones' village in the north. A chest of valuable reagents rode in it, and Biggs wants those reagents brought back.

sections.title: The Stolen Wagon
sections.body: Biggs was knocked senseless in the attack, yet glimpsed one of the caravan's wagons being dragged away to the Fallow Sanctuary, the Lost Ones' village to the north. In that wagon was a chest of reagents prized by the wizards of Nethergarde Keep for their studies. Biggs wants the chest found and its contents carried back.

sections.title: Word from Biggs
sections.body: Back with the reagents, you find Biggs pleased, for the wizards of Nethergarde can now carry on with their work. Biggs does not know what that work is, only that it has to do with the Dark Portal, over in the Blasted Lands and matters greatly to keeping the Alliance secure.

faq.answer: Watcher Biggs lost a wagon of the caravan to the Lost Ones and wants the reagents it carried recovered.

faq.q: Where did the Lost Ones take the caravan chest?
faq.answer: Biggs saw the wagon hauled away to the Fallow Sanctuary, the Lost Ones' village in the north, with the chest aboard.
The wizards of Nethergarde Keep depend on them for their studies.

faq.q: What comes after recovering the chest?
faq.answer: Driftwood follows once Biggs has the reagents.
